job_title: Logo needed for UK start up catering company
job_description:
** Thank you for sending your proposals. We look forward to reviewing them all soon. Please bear with us though as we are a bit busy but we will get back to you as soon as possible!**

We are looking for an experienced logo designer to create an original logo for our UK-based street food business, Global Dough.

Global Dough serves globally inspired street food built around dough and flatbreads, including pizzas, naan breads, wraps and other freshly prepared street food cooked in wood-fired and tandoor ovens.

What we need:
A clean, unique and professional logo
Minimalist
Modern-retro styling (not cartoonish)
Strong enough to work on the side of a food truck (see attached pic)
Simple, bold and highly legible from a distance
Suitable for social media, our website (not produced yet), menus, signage, clothing and packaging
Typography-led design preferred
We are open to subtle graphic elements, but do not want obvious globes, chef hats, food clipart or generic AI-style icons
We only want one example of a logo with subtle graphic elements. The other concepts need to be just typography as that's our preference.

Colours:
Burnt orange
Black
White

Logo should have the name of the company and our strapline:
Global Dough
Seriously Tasty Street Food

Deliverables:
3–5 initial concepts
Up to 3 revision rounds
Full colour version
Black version
White version
Vector files (AI, EPS, SVG)
PNG files with transparent background
JPGS
Font details supplied

Copyright & Ownership:
The final logo must be completely original.

No stock logos, copyrighted elements, template-based logos, or AI-generated logo artwork.

When applying please provide:

Examples of food hospitality logos you have designed.
Confirmation that your work is original and suitable for trademark use.
Your estimated turnaround time.
Your fixed-price quote.
Upon final payment, all intellectual property rights must transfer exclusively to us. The logo should be suitable for future trademark registration.

Budget: £150–£200
